column1: # SPDX-License-Identifier: CC0-1.0
# Ordinary DoH and DoT resolvers the user may choose instead of Oblivious DoH (ADR 0042, W8), one row per service
# and protocol, each with the facts of its card. Every value has its source in sources.tsv, read on 2026-11-20.
# Columns:
#   id         short name, lower case: service and protocol
#   name       the service's name as the operator writes it
#   operator   the company or organisation that runs it
#   country    the operator's seat, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2
#   protocol   doh or dot
#   endpoint   the DoH URL, or the DoT host name
#   ipv4       bootstrap addresses of the endpoint's host, comma separated
#   ipv6       bootstrap addresses of the endpoint's host, comma separated, compressed lower-case form
#   logging    the operator's own statement, in a few words of ours
#   audit      who examined the logging claim and when
#   filtering  none, or what it filters
#   policy     the URL of its privacy policy
#   pins       SPKI SHA-256 pins (sha256/BASE64); none published by any operator
#   note       free text
#   service    what the screen calls the service, beside the operator (W8's fix round, review R-M2): blocking (it
#              blocks harmful sites), unfiltered, standard (the operator's one public service)
#   logs       the logging statement as one of the screen's sentences: totals (no address kept, only counters),
#              names-day (names without addresses for a day, and counters), day (logs with the address for about a
#              day), months (logs with a masked address for months), none (it says it keeps no logs)
#   blocks     the filtering as one of the screen's sentences: none, harm (malware, phishing and the like), court
#              (what courts order)
#   audited    the audit as one of the screen's sentences: no, firm (an accounting firm examined the claims)
# '-' means none. The last four columns restate the logging, filtering, audit and name columns, which keep the
# sources' words for the record, as values the screen translates.
